_doc: Same content as docs/cards/CARDS_INTERFACES.md section 2.2, entry for entry (handoff audit 2026-10-13). The contract wins if they ever differ; the PR path check reads this file, so report a difference in an [api] issue and Claude fixes both.
Glob: ** = any depth, * = one path segment, {a,b} = alternatives. A sidecar (.uid / .import) belongs to the owner of its file.
default_owned: every task also owns these, with {ID} replaced by its task id.
human_only: paths a PR whose author is not in legal/human_authors.json may never touch; they are exactly the paths owned by "human" (A/B).
Claude owns everything not listed under a task or human, including every file that existed before the card version; the list under Claude names the ones tools and docs refer to.
W0 is Claude's skeleton wave: files owned by Claude carry _meta.owner "W0" in data.

Story packs (2026-10-22, framework wrap-up default, the lead may change it): paths.packs = packs/**, owned by the story writers (each writer owns packs/<id>/**; docs/cards/PLUGINS.md). Not in human_only and not in ai_paths: a pack declares its author kind in packs/<id>/pack.json ("source": "human" | "ai"), and check_pr_paths.py refuses a non-human author on any file of a pack whose pack.json says source human at base or head, the same rule as data/cards/text/**. AI packs need a 5-segment ai:<tool>:<model>:<date>:<id> _provenance like data/cards/text_ai/**.
